purpose: Crash-safe chaining of separately frozen scientific stages without adding scientific semantics or automatic authority promotion.

structural_series.policy: May auto-advance only on exact preregistered outcomes; novelty, changed assumptions, unregistered outcomes and review branches stop fail-closed.

research_series.policy: Adaptive only inside preregistered branches. R slots are optional; the chain may close early. A new phenomenon outside the branch table requires a new continuation registration and human review.
default_roles: R2 candidate smaller/local read and lower-bound test
R3 generic recursive hidden law/canon when earned

authority.graduation: Explicit review only; a mechanical PASS is never sufficient by itself.

durability.resume: Reuse only verified stage commits; never rerun a committed stage with a different result.
durability.external_mirror: Chain state exposes a pending mirror flag; actual connector upload remains outside the scientific worker.

execution.decoder_plan: Each prepared stage may invoke the existing guarded Decoder Controller and materialize one declared result artifact.
execution.prepared_executor: Test/extension hook for pre-registered stage executors; not a bypass around authority rules.
execution.workers: Stage plans retain their own worker leases. Chain default is metadata/policy only and does not parallelize dependent stages.
